about: Montgomery Law works from one office on John W. Carpenter Freeway and publishes 944 reviews at 4.7, a free consultation, a no-win no-fee promise and a 24 hour line.
It states no fee model in terms we could record, publishes no case results we could read, and names no attorney on the pages we could reach, which is the gate G5 asks about.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.source: Active Franchise Taxpayers (data.texas.gov 9cir-efmm), published as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, which carries the Secretary of State file number, charter date and status
G3.evidence: MONTGOMERY LAW, PLLC is registered with the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, under number 0801876697, since 2013-11-03, with an active status and the right to transact business, and 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 944 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2013-11-03, so it has been operating for more than a year
